purpose: go / no-go for the M7o comparison; the pilot's model, optimizer state and tables are never reused
checks: P1  trainer exit 0 under the M7h guard, no stop, no leftover game process
P2  accounting: sb3_num_timesteps == 307,200, n_updates == 600, the four checkpoint sets, VecNormalize statistics-free
P3  ckpt_000000000 == the fresh construction of the profile (policy + VecNormalize digests) == m7n_s0_v3's initial set
P4  every training row validates (btt_reward_v2 closed form on `return`; the explore record consistent; m7d validators)
P6  contracts: v3 observation digest, action-class table, both diagnostic flags, exploration_contract recorded
P7  resources: <= 10 game processes, no hard alert
P8  exploration accounting: every episode bonus <= 1.0 and >= 0; ground + air == bonus; learner_return == return + bonus;
P9  decay: mean bonus of the last 25 % of episodes per slot < 30 % of the first 25 % (pooled over slots); at least one
P10 evaluation of the final set from tick 0 (60 + 5, metrics on) verifies (tick-0 starts, counts, metrics, no leak)
R   regression diagnostic, stop-only: the 60 stochastic episodes' mean targets must not be below the M7n seed-0
on_failure: no-go: stop and report; no extension, no retune, no second pilot seed
on_inconclusive_regression: passes on the engineering checks; the diagnostic is reported with its sampling uncertainty

grid.size_rule: s = max(width, height) / grid_divisor from the spatial diagnostic map_bounds [top, bottom, right, left] of the tick-0 observe reply
grid.out_of_bounds: no clipping; outer cells are ordinary cells

eligible.ineligible_step: marks nothing, banks nothing, keeps pending credit pending

exploration_contract.first_visit: first eligible step of the episode in the cell; the tick-0 reset observation marks its cell visited without credit
exploration_contract.amount: beta * w(n), n = earlier episodes of this worker slot that visited the cell; w(n) = 1 / (1 + n); computed at the visit
exploration_contract.grounded: ground_air_state 0: banked on the visiting step
exploration_contract.airborne: pending; banked in visit order on the next eligible grounded step (a landing on any floor); voided at native failure, at the horizon and at any episode end before such a landing
exploration_contract.cap: banked credit per episode <= cap; the excess of a credit is dropped (recorded as capped); pending amounts keep their computed value until banking
exploration_contract.permanence: banked credit is never undone; a fall after a landing keeps the landing's credit (no claw-back rule)
exploration_contract.counts: at every episode end n += 1 for every visited cell, whether banked, voided or capped
exploration_contract.learner: the banked amount joins the contract reward of the same step (grounded: the visiting step; airborne: the landing step); no retroactive attribution
exploration_contract.tables: one per worker slot (rank); persists across game-process restarts and standby promotions; written after every episode to <worker_dir>/explore_table.json and reloaded on resume of the same run; empty in a fresh run; never imported across runs
exploration_contract.episode_state: visited set and pending list cleared at reset; never checkpointed
exploration_contract.not_observed: the policy observation contract is unchanged; the visited set and tables are reward state only

attempt.outcome: stopped by the M7h guard on a monitor hard alert after 56,320 transitions (11 rollouts, 110 PPO updates, 15 episodes): the m7d row check compared the per-episode record's separately rounded banked_ground + banked_air with its rounded bonus at a 1e-6 tolerance and flagged a 1e-6 rounding difference (rank 2 episode 3: 0.033333 + 0.508333 vs 0.541667); the mechanism's accounting was consistent; fix = exact floats in the record and 1e-5 tolerances (rl/btt_explore_cells.py, rl/m7d_run.py, rl/m7o_pilot.py); the run is preserved under runs/m7o/pilot/_partial/m7o_pilot_s0__20260927T154130Z; nothing of it is reused
